description: Source code for BN_CTX, a context structure used in OpenSSL for big number (BIGNUM) operations, including functions for creating, initializing, freeing, starting, ending, and retrieving BIGNUMs within a context.

methods.name: BN_CTX_new
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new BN_CTX structure.

methods.name: BN_CTX_free
methods.description: Frees a BN_CTX structure and its associated resources.

methods.name: BN_CTX_start
methods.description: Marks the start of a new BIGNUM allocation scope within the context.

methods.name: BN_CTX_get
methods.description: Retrieves a BIGNUM from the context, or returns NULL if none available.

methods.name: BN_CTX_end
methods.description: Ends the current BIGNUM allocation scope within the context.
